## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 期间 | 收入（百万美元） |
|---|---|
| FY26 Q4（截至 2026/6/30） | $39,306 |
| FY25 Q4（截至 2025/6/30） | $29,878 |

同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 = 9,428 / 29,878 ≈ **31.6%**，按报告口径四舍五入为 **32%**（恒定汇率口径为 31%）。

**出处**：`press_release.txt` 位置 ~18895 处的分部收入表格，以及 `transcript.txt` 位置 ~24808 管理层开场白。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

来自 `transcript.txt` 位置 ~24700–25200 Amy Hood 对 Intelligent Cloud 板块的讲解：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That **additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

此外，现场服务器业务（on-premises server）"was relatively unchanged year-over-year… primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述 逐条标注

| # | 归因陈述 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Azure 收入同比增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 描述的是本季度（Q4 FY26）实际报告的结果，有具体数字 |
| 2 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **对当前状态的判断（偏事实性描述）** | 使用现在时态"continues"，描述的是截止本季度末仍在持续的供需状态，是管理层对当前经营环境的陈述 |
| 3 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生事实** | "was ahead of expectations" 是对本季度实际结果 vs 内部预算的事后归因 |
| 4 | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生事实** | 描述本季度已完成的流程改进及其效果 |
| 5 | "additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生事实** | "was monetized" 是过去时，描述本季度内已发生的变现行为 |
| 6 | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生事实** | "consumption" 是本季度实际发生的业务结果，6 月的商业模式变更已落地 |
| 7 | on-premises server "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生事实** | 对本季度已确认收入的结构性归因 |
| 8 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻性表述** | "remain focused on"、"bridge the gaps we see" 指向未来持续要做的事情 |
| 9 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | 明确使用 "continue to expect"，是对未来半年（H1 FY27）增长趋势的预测 |
| 10 | "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix" | **前瞻性表述（风险提示）** | 对未来季度增长率波动性的预告 |
| 11 | "we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%" | **前瞻性表述** | 明确的 Q1 FY27 业绩指引 |

**关键区分逻辑**：
- **事实层**：动词时态为过去式（"grew"、"was"、"benefited"、"was monetized"）或是对本季度已发生状态的描述；这些是可验证的已实现业绩归因。
- **前瞻层**：动词为 "expect"、"remain focused on"、"continue to" 等指向未来的表述，或涉及"we see"、"we believe"等主观判断未来走势的措辞；这些属于管理层指引（guidance），不构成已实现业绩。

**结论**：本季度 32% 的增长归因主要落在**已实现的事实层面**（效率提升、产能变现、Copilot 消费超预期），管理层对未来则同时传递了乐观信号（H1 加速、Q1 指引 33–34%）和不确定性提示（产能时间节奏与合同结构会导致季度间波动）。
